title: Enrollment Stage and Months Counted on Pre-Supply C&I Terminations
content:
**§ Termination before supply: enrollment stage** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

The months counted for a termination before supply depend on how far the enrollment had gone: a contract with no utility confirmation date and no security deposit posted, whose enrollment was therefore never submitted to the utility, counts at most 12 of its term months; a contract with a security deposit posted but no utility confirmation date counts at most 18 of its term months; a contract the utility had confirmed counts its full term months.

"At most" means the lesser of the contract's term months and the figure stated. The utility confirmation date is read from the contract record; a security deposit is posted when the contract carries a security deposit receipt.

## Truth table

| Utility confirmation date | Security deposit posted | Months counted | Term 12 | Term 24 | Term 36 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | none | lesser of term months and 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| none | yes | lesser of term months and 18 | 12 | 18 | 18 |
| recorded | none | full term months | 12 | 24 | 36 |
| recorded | yes | full term months | 12 | 24 | 36 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A 36-month contract terminated before any deposit or utility confirmation: 12 months counted.
- A 24-month contract with a deposit receipt but no utility confirmation date: 18 months counted.
- A 24-month contract the utility had confirmed: 24 months counted.
